text: The Terms of Reference for the Toronto Music Advisory Committee state that the Committee will hold up to four meetings per year at the call of the Chair or Vice-Chair on the delegation of the Chair. City staff will propose dates for public meetings of Toronto Music Advisory Committee in 2026, for member feedback and discussion. The following meetings are scheduled for 2026: Date: Monday, February 9, 2026 Time: 10:00 a.m. Location: Committee Room 1/Video Conference Date: Monday, May 25, 2026 Time: 2:00 p.m. Location: Committee Room 1/Video Conference
The Toronto Music Advisory Committee received the item for information.
